scope: All18 native primaries and all three complete six-panel reader flows; source-bound pre-repair assessment.
capture_note: Actual offline reader tabs; full pages and consecutive two-panel strips. To resolve lazy image decoding for offscreen screenshots, image loading was set eager in the temporary browser tab only; no saved reader/art changes.

phone_findings.13: Broad boast/break/help/pet/joke sequence is understandable, white sleeves separate arms. But P02 shows bare rim manipulation, so the large detached wood inP03 lacks its pictured cause; duplicated woodP05 and rebuilt/tipped wheelP06 undermine persistence.
phone_findings.18: Strongest phone expression and color separation; surprised break and amused payoff read without zoom. Still, third wood pieceP03 and invented barP04 contradict the simple mechanism, andP06 resets wheel/hand/barrier state.
phone_findings.19: The broad gag remains readable, but dark masonry/costumes compress smaller hand and prop evidence. Two handlesP02 and unsupported water-standingP05 remain visible hard contradictions; laterality and grip persistence fail even when the dialogue flows.

cross_sequence_result: No complete primary treatment meets all frozen mechanics/continuity requirements. The six retries below are bounded high-value experiments, not enough to guarantee all three sequences will satisfy every requirement.

recommended_repairs.target: Restore the causal grip: exactly one wooden crank, anatomical RIGHT hand on it; anatomical LEFT directly on upper-left rim. Presently neither hand touches the wood.
Remove the extra airborne wood segment: exactly one small mounted jagged stub plus one right-held matching remnant, with clear air gap.
Remove duplicated crank: exactly one intact rim-mounted wood grip, right hand holding it; left hand on bare iron rim.
Ground both Mara sandals on dry ledge and retain downward left-palm shell contact; Iven keeps exactly one remnant in RIGHT hand, left empty; no duplicate held wood.
Remove duplicate held wood: right remnant only, left empty, mounted broken stub persistent. Keep dry-foot shell touch and establish downstream/rightward creature if achievable in same shot.
Remove invented horizontal bar: both Mara hands directly on opposite iron rim, short broken stub stays, gate part-lifted and creature still waits upstream.

remaining_unrepaired_faults: All threeP01 images crop or fail to demonstrate all four tentacles and stage the creature screen-right facing left.
18-P02 anatomical left crank/right rim ownership is opposite the prescribed relationship;19-P03 retains the remnant in anatomical left hand.
All threeP06 images hold wood in anatomical left hand and show restored/repositioned intact-looking wheel grips;13/18 also change wheel plane toward horizontal.
18-P06 introduces a low closed secondary barrier under the raised gate.
13/19P04 allow the creature under/at the opening early and show a long smooth mounted grip rather than the broken stub.
Prop diameter/length and wheel scale/mounting drift between cuts.
Creature travel is not consistently screen-left to screen-right and exact four-tentacle whole-body evidence is not sustained.
decision_boundary: No final production/art or owner acceptance. Lead owns retry launches; no controls/art were modified during review.
